title: Congenital Anomalies of the Kidney and Urinary Tract (CAKUT) Masterclass
description: 整合 CAKUT 胚胎發育與分子的訊號機制、腎臟實質發育異常、上與下泌尿道結構發育畸形及 Posterior Urethral Valves (PUV) 臨床急處置之專科課程。

sections.title: Module 1: Embryology, Reciprocal Induction & Molecular Genetics of CAKUT
sections.content:
### 1.MMUB 之間的 Reciprocal Induction。Metanephric Mesenchyme 分泌 GDNF，Mesonephric Duct 上表面的 RET Receptor與 GFRalpha1 Cofactor，誘導 Ureteric Bud 萌出並侵入 Metanephric Mesenchyme 進行 Iterative Branching Morphogenesis。

| Developmental Stage | Key Regulatory Molecules | Morphogenetic Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ureteric Bud Induction | GDNF, RET, GFRalpha1, WNT11 | Site-specific outgrowth of Ureteric Bud from Wolffian Duct |
| Mesenchyme Condensation | PAX2, WT1, EYA1, SIX1 | Epithelialization of Metanephric Mesenchyme into Renal Vesicles |
| Nephron Lineage Specification | WNT4, FGF8,LHX1 | Transition from Comma-shaped and S-shaped bodies to mature Nephrons |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Syndrome | Mutated Gene | Extrarenal Clinical Manifestations | CAKUT Phenotype |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Renal Coloboma Syndrome | PAX2 | Optic Nerve Coloboma, Sensorineural Hearing Loss | Renal Hypoplasia, Dysplasia,VUR |
|RCAD |TCF2 | Pancreatic Hypoplasia, Maturity-MODY5, Gout |MCDK, Hypomagnesemia, Renal Agenesis |
| Branchio-Oto-BOR Syndrome | EYA1, SIX1, SIX5 | Branchial Cleft Cysts/Fistulae, Preauricular Pits, Hearing Loss | Renal Agenesis, Dysplasia,UPJO |
| HDR Syndrome | GATA3 | Hypoparathyroidism, Sensorineural Deafness | Renal Dysplasia, Hypoplasia, Duplex Collecting System |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Aberrant GDNF/RET Signaling Lineage ➔ Abnormal Position of Ureteric Bud Outgrowth ➔ Ectopic Ureteric Bud Insertion ➔ Ectopic UB too Rostral ➔ Ectopic Ureter / Ureterocele & Upper Pole Obstruction ➔ Ectopic UB too Caudal ➔ Short Intravesical Submucosal Tunnel ➔ Incompetent Vesicoureteral Valve ➔VUR.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為 PAX2 基因突變引起的 Syndromic CAKUT 主要表現為 Diabetes Mellitus 與 Pancreatic Hypoplasia。
**Analysis**:MODY5TCF2 RCAD Syndrome；而 PAX2 突變引發的是 Renal Coloboma Syndrome，特徵為 Optic Nerve Coloboma 與 Sensorineural Hearing Loss。

sections.title: Module 2: Renal Parenchymal Malformations (Renal Agenesis, Dysplasia & Fusion Anomalies)
sections.content:
### 1. Parenchymal Malformation Matrix

Renal Parenchymal Malformations 代表 Metanephric Differentiation 階段的結構缺陷，包含 Bilateral/Unilateral Renal Agenesis、Renal Dysplasia/Hypoplasia、MCDK 及 Horseshoe Kidney。

| Anomaly | Histopathological & Anatomical Features | Natural History & Clinical Management |
| --- | --- | --- |
|MCDK | Primitive Ductules surrounded by Fibromuscular Collars, Dysplastic Cartilage, non-communicating Cysts | Involution over time;VUR |
| Horseshoe Kidney | Inferior Pole Fusion forming Isthmus;IMA |UPJO, Nephrolithiasis, Wilms Tumor |
| Renal Hypodysplasia | Reduced Nephron Number with Dysplastic Stroma | Hyperfiltration Injury, Proteinuria, Secondary FSGS,CKD |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Feature |MCDK |ARPKD |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cyst Morphology | Multiple Large Non-communicating Cysts |Radial Cysts |
| Functionality | Non-functioning affected kidney | Bilateral impaired renal function at birth |
| Renogram/Scan | Complete absence of perfusion & excretion | Delayed symmetric excretion with bilateral nephromegaly |
| Associated Anomalies | Contralateral VUR / UPJO | Congenital Hepatic Fibrosis, Portal Hypertension |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Fusion of Metanephric Blastema at Lower Poles ➔ Embryonic Ascent of Fused Kidney ➔IMA at L3 Level ➔ Cephalad Ascent Arrested ➔ Horseshoe Kidney in Low Lumbar Position ➔ High Ureteral Insertion over Isthmus ➔ Urinary Stasis ➔ Complications: Nephrolithiasis &UPJO.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**:MCDK 的新生兒，首選治療策略為緊急 Surgical Nephrectomy。
**Analysis**: 現行臨床指引推薦Conservative Management，因為大多數 MCDK 會隨時間Involution。VUR 或 UPJO。

sections.title: Module 3: Upper & Lower Urinary Tract Anomalies (VUR, Duplex System & UPJO)
sections.content:
### 1.VUR、Duplex Collecting System、Ectopic Ureter、UPJO。

| Disorder | Anatomic Defect | Diagnostic Hallmark |
| --- | --- | --- |
|VUR | Incompetent Intravesical Submucosal Tunnel Valve |VCUG |
| Duplex System & Weigert-Meyer Law | Upper Pole Ureter inserts Ectopically/Medially; Lower Pole Ureter inserts Normally/Laterally | Upper Pole Ureterocele / Obstruction;VUR |
|UPJO | Intrinsic Fibromuscular Disruption at UPJ | Hydronephrosis without Ureteral Dilation; MAG3 T1/2 > 20 min |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| VUR Grade | Ureteral & Calyceal Architecture | Management Strategy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Grade I | Reflux into Ureter only without dilation | Conservative observation |
| Grade II | Reflux into Renal Pelvis without calyceal blunting | Antibiotics prophylaxis or observation |
| Grade III | Mild dilation of Ureter and Pelvis; mild calyceal blunting |CAP |
| Grade IV - V | Moderate-to-severe Ureteral Tortuosity, Pelvicalyceal Dilation & Loss of Impression |Deflux or Surgical Ureteral Reimplantation |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Duplex Collecting System ➔ Upper Pole vs Lower Pole Ureter Budding ➔ Upper Pole Ureter Bud originates Rostral on Mesonephric Duct ➔ Delayed incorporation into Bladder Trigone ➔ Ectopic insertion Medial & Inferior ➔ Ureterocele & Upper Pole Obstruction / Hydronephrosis ➔ Lower Pole Ureter Bud originates Caudal ➔ Early incorporation into Bladder ➔ Lateral Ectopic insertion with Short Submucosal Tunnel ➔VUR.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 在男性與女性 Ectopic Ureter 患者中，以為兩者均會表現為 Continuous Incontinence。
**Analysis**: 女性 Ectopic Ureter 可穿過 External Sphincter 進入 Vagina 或 Urethra，表現為 Continuous Dribbling Incontinence despite normal periodic voiding；而男性 Ectopic Ureter 一律插入 External Sphincter 之近端 (如 Prostatic Urethra, Seminal Vesicles)，因此男性絕對不會表現為 Ectopic Incontinence，而是表現為 Recurrent Epididymitis 或 Bladder Outlet Obstruction。

sections.title: Module 4: Lower Tract Obstruction, Fetal Management & Potter Sequence
sections.content:
### 1. Severe Obstruction &PUVLUTO，常引發 Severe Oligohydramnios 與 Potter Sequence。

| Disease State | Key Diagnostic Sign | Pathophysiology & Sequelae |
| --- | --- | --- |
|PUV | Keyhole Sign on Ultrasound & VCUG | Congenital Membranous Valve in Prostatic Urethra ➔ Severe Bladder Outlet Obstruction ➔ Bilateral Hydroureteronephrosis & Renal Dysplasia |
| Potter Sequence | Pulmonary Hypoplasia, Compressed Facies, Limb Deformities | Severe In Utero Renal Dysfunction or LUTO ➔ Oligohydramnios ➔ Uterine Wall Compression of Fetus |
| Reflux Nephropathy |FSGS, Cortical Scarring | Intrarenal Reflux ➔ Chronic Interstitial Nephritis ➔ Hypertension, Proteinuria & Progressive CKD |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Parameter |PUV |UPJO |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Patient Gender | Exclusively Males | Male-to-Female ~2:1 |
| Affected Structure | Prostatic Urethra | Ureteropelvic Junction |
| Bladder Wall | Thickened & Trabeculated with Keyhole Sign | Normal thin Bladder Wall |
| Ureteral Dilation | Bilateral Hydroureteronephrosis | Hydronephrosis WITHOUT Ureteral Dilation |
| Definitive Treatment | Transurethral Endoscopic Valve Ablation |Dismembered Pyeloplasty |

### 3.PUV ➔LUTO ➔ Massively Distended Bladder & Bilateral Hydroureteronephrosis ➔ Impaired Fetal Urine Production ➔ Severe Oligohydramnios in Utero ➔ Loss of Amniotic Fluid Cushion ➔ Compression of Fetal Chest & Facies ➔Main Cause of Neonatal Mortality & Potter Facies ➔ Postnatal Emergency: Immediate Urinary Decompression with Feeding Tube/Catheter ➔ Electrolyte Balance ➔ Endoscopic Valve Ablation.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**:PUV，急診處置第一步直覺安排開腹 Surgical Valve Resection。
**Analysis**: PUV 的急診處置首要步驟是立即以小號 Feeding Tube 或 Transurethral Catheter 進行 Urinary Decompression，such as Hyperkalemia and Metabolic Acidosis。待病情穩定後，確定治療首選為微創 Endoscopic Transurethral Valve Ablation，非開放式手術。
